{{Quote|Nahhhh. Ran into an old smuggler pal turned code dealer at the spaceport, and got him to sell me this month's access codes to the big CYN.|Gabriel|<ref name="GNN3" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''code dealer''' sold the access codes to [[Cynabar's InfoNet]] to the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Gabriel]]. He had been a former smuggler and associate of Gabriel's, and she convinced him to sell her the codes after running into him at a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="GNN3" />
